mapper.select: INSERT INTO company ( slug, name, company_market, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{slug}, #{name}, #{companyMarket}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (slug) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, company_market = EXCLUDED.company_market, updated_at = NOW() RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO problem_company_signal ( problem_id, company_id, role, recency_bucket, frequency_score, rank, acceptance_rate, source_name, source_url, source_commit, source_problem_url, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT p.id, #{companyId}, #{role}, #{recencyBucket}, #{frequencyScore}, #{rank}, #{acceptanceRate}, #{sourceName}, #{sourceUrl}, #{sourceCommit}, #{sourceProblemUrl}, NOW(), NOW() FROM problem p WHERE p.slug = #{problemSlug} ON CONFLICT (problem_id, company_id, role, recency_bucket, source_name) DO UPDATE SET frequency_score = EXCLUDED.frequency_score, rank = EXCLUDED.rank, acceptance_rate = EXCLUDED.acceptance_rate, source_url = EXCLUDED.source_url, source_commit = EXCLUDED.source_commit, source_problem_url = EXCLUDED.source_problem_url, updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO problem_company_import_run ( source_name, source_commit, manifest_path, matched_signal_count, skipped_signal_count, error_count, metadata_json, created_at ) VALUES ( #{sourceName}, #{sourceCommit}, #{manifestPath}, #{matchedSignalCount}, #{skippedSignalCount}, #{errorCount}, CAST(#{metadataJson} AS JSONB), NOW() )
